inputs.original_text: Workers employed in the support programmes of the Ministry of Education, Sport and Youth staged a protest outside the Presidential Palace on Thursday and announced a 24-hour strike, calling for legally binding job security guarantees — even as the government argued it had already delivered on the most significant demands. At the heart of the [...]
inputs.modified_text: Support-programme workers at the Ministry of Education, Sport and Youth are demanding legally binding job security, not assurances from a government that says it has already met the main demands. Their protest outside the Presidential Palace and 24-hour strike show the imbalance workers face when their livelihoods depend on promises rather than enforceable protections. If the government has delivered, it should be willing to guarantee that security in law.
